## WhatsApp Support Agent
Answers routine customer questions in seconds from your own FAQ and order data, and hands complaints to a person with the full context.

Incoming WhatsApp messages are classified (order status, price, delivery, returns, complaint, greeting). Known questions are answered from YOUR FAQ, order numbers are looked up, and complaints or unknowns go to a human on Slack. Replace the FAQ and ORDERS constants, or swap ORDERS for an HTTP call to your store.

**Try it:** click *Test workflow* to run on the sample data. Then connect your credentials on the output nodes and activate.

Code and docs: github.com/Princewill106/whatsapp-support-agent
